meta.name: dot-ai-query-dot-ai
meta.description: Query sibling dot-ai projects to verify features are USABLE (not just defined). IMPORTANT: When calling this skill, explain HOW you plan to use the feature (e.g., 'I need to call X via REST API from the UI' or 'I need to import Y function'). This helps verify the full chain from definition to exposure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证功能是否真正可用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发中确认功能不仅定义而且可用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to confirm features are usable, not just defined

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询同目录下的其他 dot-ai 项目代码，验证某个功能是否真正可用（不只是定义存在），并给出具体用法。
howto.when: 当用户询问某个功能是否存在，或要求确认功能是否可实际调用时触发。

say.text: 检查 dot-ai 项目中是否有通过 REST API 暴露的 X 功能？
say.note: Claude 会查询代码并说明如何调用。

say.text: 验证 dot-ai-ui 里 Y 函数是否可导入使用。
say.note: Claude 会追踪从定义到暴露的完整路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query sibling dot-ai project codebases to verify whether a feature is actually usable (not just defined) and provide concrete usage instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks whether a feature exists or requests confirmation that a feature is callable in practice.

say_en.text: Check if feature X is exposed via REST API in the dot-ai project.
say_en.note: Claude will query the code and explain how to call it.

say_en.text: Verify if function Y in dot-ai-ui is importable and usable.
say_en.note: Claude will trace the path from definition to exposure.
